propositions: Pure single-pass prepacked verification produces false-positive rejections when prepack is imperfect; a filter that only PASSes or ABSTAINs (never rejects) eliminates false-positive rejection by construction.

A two-stage approach (deterministic single-pass filter + agentic fallback narrowed to abstained ACs) achieves -26% token cost overall and -46% on all-met tickets while maintaining zero false-positive passes.

Filter coverage is bimodal by AC style: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) PASS from static packs at 80-90% rate; ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN.
The existing criteria-reduction seam (AC-block rewrite at ticket load via monkeypatch of show_ticket) automatically narrows agentic step budget and works cleanly including epic child traversal.

Prepack quality and AC style determine filter viability; productization requires enforcement of PASS/ABSTAIN-only contract, per-AC citation recording, coverage telemetry by AC style, and validation that description remains <=8000 chars after reduction.
